wiki.title: Myron Tsosie
wiki.extract: Myron Tsosie is an American politician and a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives representing District 6 since January 9, 2023. He previously represented District 7 from 2019 to 2023. Tsosie was elected in 2018 to succeed retiring State Representative Eric Descheenie. Tsosie is a member of the Navajo Nation.
